tasks.task: Create `server.js` with Express app, in-memory todos, listening on port.
Add POST `/todos` route to `server.js` for adding new tasks.
Add GET `/todos` route to `server.js` for fetching all tasks.
Add PUT `/todos/:id/complete` route to `server.js` for marking tasks.
Create `frontend/index.html` with todo input, list, and filter buttons.
Create `frontend/style.css` to style todo items, input, and filters.
Create `frontend/app.js` to fetch and render todos on page load.
Add event listeners to `frontend/app.js` for complete and filter actions.

files.explanation: This file sets up an Express server, defines routes for todo operations, and listens on a specified port.
This file defines the HTML structure for the todo list application, including input, list, and filter buttons.
This file defines the CSS styles for the todo list application, including layout and visual styling.
This file defines the JavaScript logic for the todo list application, including fetching and rendering todos, and handling user interactions.
